task.description: Validate src/design/onboarding_gui.md against ONB-UI-01..04. HARD GATE — FRONTEND-DEV cannot start until this returns PASS.
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion in ONB-UI-01..04 has a corresponding design element in the doc
No implementation code (TypeScript, React, CSS) is present in the design
All public screen interfaces are listed by name and behaviour
Error taxonomy covers all API error codes from POST /api/v1/onboarding

result.summary: Design artefact for onboarding_gui.md contains 1 BLOCKER (implementation code in section 6.1) and 2 MAJOR issues (spurious HTTP 400 in error taxonomy; missing HTTP 502 coverage) — FRONTEND-DEV cannot start until rework is complete.

issues.description: Section 6.1 contains a TypeScript/JavaScript object literal ({ to: '/admin/onboarding/new', label: 'Register Tenant', roles: ['PLATFORM_ADMIN'] }) inside a fenced code block. This is implementation code in a design document. Design documents must not contain function bodies, data-structure literals, SQL DDL, or JSX. Replace with a prose description of the NAV_ITEMS entry shape.

Error taxonomy section 9.2 lists HTTP 400 as a possible response from POST /api/v1/onboarding with the label 'Malformed JSON'. The actual backend (onboarding.zig handleOnboarding) never returns 400 — malformed or missing-field bodies are rejected with 422 (validation_failed). Documenting a status code the backend never emits will cause FRONTEND-DEV to add dead-code handlers and miss the real 422 flow. Remove the 400 row and clarify that malformed JSON is covered by the existing 422 validation_failed row.

Error taxonomy section 9.2 does not cover HTTP 502. The backend onboardingErrorToStatus() maps RealmProvisioningFailed, UserProvisioningFailed, RoleAssignmentFailed, ClientProvisioningFailed, and VerificationFailed to 502. These are realistic saga execution failures and FRONTEND-DEV must handle them. The current taxonomy's '5xx (other)' generic row partially covers this, but the design should explicitly call out 502 as the expected code for provisioning-step failures so the UI can show a meaningful message rather than a generic error.

The design uses 'pending' as the ongoing saga state (sections 4.2, 7.2) but ONB-UI-03 requirement text uses 'fresh' and 'in_progress'. The design is consistent with the actual backend implementation (onboarding.zig uses pending/completed/failed). Add a note in section 4.2 clarifying that the backend state enum uses 'pending' (not 'fresh'/'in_progress') and that this design follows the backend implementation.

ONB-UI-03 and ONB-UI-04 requirements state that a non-PLATFORM_ADMIN direct URL access 'redirects to the login screen', but section 6.2 of the design redirects to '/instances'. The design pattern is consistent with existing admin pages (HealthDashboardPage, AuditLogPage) and is correct per implementation. Add a note in section 6.2 acknowledging the requirement wording ('login screen') and explaining that '/instances' is the existing admin redirect target for authenticated users lacking PLATFORM_ADMIN, while unauthenticated users are handled upstream by ProtectedRoute.

result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGNER for rework: fix section 6.1 (remove implementation code), update section 9.2 (remove spurious 400 row, add explicit 502 row for provisioning failures), add clarifying notes per MINOR issues.
